referenceLibrary.name: EYECANDY Visual Technique Library
referenceLibrary.rightsRule: Technique names and visual-language references only. Do not copy or redistribute third-party clips, GIFs, frames, or artwork.

selectedTechniques.name: Floating UI
selectedTechniques.guidance: Layer interface-like objects in depth so the viewer reads a system rather than a static slide.

selectedTechniques.name: Central Framing
selectedTechniques.guidance: Keep the primary subject or product mechanism locked near center while secondary motion creates depth.

selectedTechniques.name: Crash Cut
selectedTechniques.guidance: Cut abruptly between two strongly contrasting visual states to create a clean attention reset.

selectedTechniques.name: Close-Up
selectedTechniques.guidance: Open tight on one decisive visual detail, then reveal the larger system.

visualDirector.usageRule: Borrow technique vocabulary and shot logic only. Never download/reuse EYECANDY example footage unless separate commercial rights are verified.

pacing.explanation: 4s onward: Remotion/Canva-derived authored UI, typography and diagrams
pacing.transitions: Use one deliberate technique change per major idea; avoid random motion for its own sake.

seedance25.prompt: 9:16 premium cinematic motion-design hook, 4 seconds, silent video, no captions and no readable text. Visualize the core idea of Cross-Agent Operating Kit — Personal as an original abstract operational system rather than a literal app screenshot. Camera language: Floating UI for the opening, Central Framing for depth and reveal, then a restrained Crash Cut transition. Start with multiple independent interface nodes drifting out of alignment, then converge into one clean central policy/control layer. Near-black environment, silver-white structures, restrained cool-blue light, subtle depth, physically plausible camera movement, premium B2B technology advertising finish. No people, no faces, no celebrity likeness, no logos, no third-party brand marks, no copyrighted characters, no watermarks, no generated typography, no flashing or strobing.
seedance25.fallback: If paid generation is not explicitly enabled or API credentials are unavailable, keep the authored Remotion hook. Publication must not be blocked.

remotionIntegration.role: Use Seedance only as a short cinematic hook/background layer. Keep facts, claims, pricing, CTA and readable text in authored Remotion/Canva layers.
